source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Reporting requirements applying mainly to healthcare facilities themselves, rather than extending to individual providers as well","B":"Hepatitis B is a reportable condition in all states, requiring notification to public health authorities to support surveillance and contact management","C":"Only chronic hepatitis B cases actually requiring public health reporting, rather than newly diagnosed acute cases as well","D":"Reporting to public health authorities being treated as an entirely optional step left up to each provider's own discretion"}}
source_row.rationale: Hepatitis B is a reportable condition in all states, requiring notification to public health authorities to support disease surveillance and appropriate contact management (such as identifying others who may need post-exposure prophylaxis or testing).
